title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening

info.about: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening is a 1993 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy. It is the first installment in The Legend of Zelda series to be released on a handheld game console.
info.why: The 2019 Switch remake sent players back to the 1993 original, which was replaced at retail by the 1998 Game Boy Color DX reissue.
